Short knees relaxed, neither leg leading a step, neither heel raised, no lifted knee, no airborne boot. Torso upright and weight centered, gentle neutral closed-mouth smile. Ponytails, red ribbons, gown and tassels hang naturally with stable small arcs, not strongly blown behind. Same chibi scale as image3, body root x512 ground y942/1024, all tips visible inside square.
